title: PLAIN LANGUAGE QUESTING CHECK-IN
description: The feature rebuilds routine play around the moment a player considers leaving. Quest text now says what to do before explaining which ancient committee made it necessary. Consecutive logins now build toward escalating rewards that reset just slowly enough to feel merciful.
consequence: Players discovered the objective without consulting three tabs and a priest. The calendar was promoted from reminder to game mechanic.

title: PLAIN LANGUAGE QUESTING BREATHER
description: The release frames the feature as seasonal structure, while burying the real priority in the reward cadence. Quest text now says what to do before explaining which ancient committee made it necessary. Daily chores have been shortened so players can leave before the evening becomes a second job.
consequence: Players discovered the objective without consulting three tabs and a priest. Engagement dipped, but so did the farewell essays.

title: MINIMAL GUIDANCE MODE CHECK-IN
description: The change decides which delays are atmosphere and which delays are invoices. Several prompts have been removed so discovery can emerge naturally from confusion and patch forum archaeology. Consecutive logins now build toward escalating rewards that reset just slowly enough to feel merciful.
consequence: The tutorial got shorter. So did the time before players asked what was happening. The calendar was promoted from reminder to game mechanic.
